extracted.name: Slow Cooker Italian Beef Stew
extracted.description: This slow cooker Italian beef stew features plenty of vegetables and a rich red wine and tomato broth, making it a soothing dish for chilly evenings.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 cup all-purpose flour, or as needed
0.25 teaspoon onion powder, or more to taste
0.25 teaspoon garlic powder, or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Whisk together flour, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper in a large shallow bowl. Add beef to seasoned flour and toss until evenly coated; shake off any excess flour.

Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook beef in hot oil, stirring occasionally, until browned on all sides, 5 to 10 minutes. Transfer beef to the slow cooker; add carrots, onion, potatoes, celery, and garlic.
Whisk together red wine, beef broth, tomato paste, and rosemary in a small bowl until smooth; pour over beef and vegetables.
Cook on Low until beef and vegetables are tender, 4 to 6 hours.
